accuracy_to_source_and_ruling.note: Every Gulf reference of the pack is named «خلیج عرب» with no izafat sign; the adjective is rebuilt as a phrase; exceptions (road, Council) kept byte for byte. Deduction: in the visa guide three positions (ur-60, ur-62, ur-66) turned a GCC reference (en «GCC residents», ar «دول المجلس» route) into «خلیج عرب کے ممالک», so the page named one group two ways; corrected by judge edits. Scored on final.

naturalness.note: Possessive builds are grammatical and agree («خلیج عرب کی نیلاہٹ», «خلیج عرب کے کنارے», «خلیج عرب بھر کا»). Residual: the name itself is unfamiliar to a Pakistani reader (first read as «بحیرہ عرب») — the inherent cost of the owner ruling, not a drafting fault; «خلیج عرب کے خطے» is heavier than the old «خلیجی خطے».

consistency.note: One base form across 51 positions and all forms listed. After the judge edits the visa guide uses the Council name wherever the source means GCC, and the stores page ties the agreement to the states it names.

constraint_compliance.note: Validated by script on final: ids and current match the pack; no bare «خلیج» outside «خلیج عرب» / «خلیج تعاون کونسل»; no «خلیجی», no «خلیج فارس»; no forbidden letterform (ي ك ة ه ى أ إ ۃ, U+0650, U+06C2); ASCII quote counts equal; no newline; only the Gulf expression and the grammar it forces changed.

judge_edits.from: خلیج عرب کے ممالک کا اقامہ
judge_edits.to: خلیج تعاون کونسل کے کسی ملک کا اقامہ

The official name, an allowed exception, keeps the table cell and its row label («خلیج تعاون کونسل کے ممالک میں مقیم افراد») one group; build «کے کسی ملک کا اقامہ» is the approved ur-63 wording («خلیج تعاون کونسل کے کسی ملک میں مقیم افراد»). Answers blind finding 2.

judge_edits.to: خلیج عرب کے ممالک کے اقتصادی معاہدے
judge_edits.why: The adjective «الخليجية» refers to the Gulf states (the agreement is between states, not of a sea); the reader could not place «خلیج عرب کے اقتصادی معاہدے». Built with the page's own «خلیج عرب کے ممالک» of the preceding sentence (ur-52), so the agreement is tied to the states just named. GCC is not written here: neither source names the Council on this page (no new fact).

rulings.title: Base form and P5 superseded
rulings.ruling: «خلیج عرب» with the Urdu possessive and no izafat sign (P8) for every reference to the Gulf — sea, coast, region, states, cuisine, heritage. «خلیجی» is never written; it is rebuilt as «خلیج عرب کے …» with the head noun. A repeated reference in the same passage carries the name too. Never «خلیج فارس».
rulings.precedent: Owner ruling O-GULF 2026-10-27 (BRIEF); tr P5 «Arap Körfezi»; P8 izafat.

rulings.title: Unfamiliarity of the name (reader: first read as «بحیرہ عرب»): mitigation
rulings.ruling: Accepted as the inherent cost of the owner ruling, with no locator added in this batch. Reason: every page where the Gulf is the sea already locates it from its own text — «سعودی عرب کے مشرقی ساحل» (al-uqair, 48-hours, worth-visiting, trails), «الاحساء کے مشرقی حصے میں» (uqair-castle, uqair-mosque, uqair-beach, al-uqair), «قطر» (salwa-beach, sinyar) — and the reader resolved the name from that context on every page. A further locator would add a third stock phrase to sentences the reader already found repeated, and the mandate is the Gulf expression only. The mitigation that is warranted is where the name created a real ambiguity of meaning, not a pause: the visa guide (deferred to the official «خلیج تعاون کونسل» where the source means GCC) and the stores agreement (tied to the states named). If the owner wants a locator, the on-record form is «سعودی عرب کے مشرقی ساحل کے ساتھ خلیج عرب», once, at the first mention on a page that names the sea without any location — built from the site's own geography, never «خلیج فارس».
rulings.precedent: ru P8 and tr Kare/Busalih: name collisions accepted as inherent, mitigation only where the reader is misled, not merely slowed.

rulings.title: Visa guide: «Gulf states» that mean the GCC
rulings.ruling: Where the source means the Gulf Cooperation Council (en «GCC», ar «دول المجلس» / «مجلس التعاون الخليجي» / the section id «gcc»), the Urdu writes the official name «خلیج تعاون کونسل» (allowed exception), never «خلیج عرب کے ممالک», so one page does not name one group two ways. Applied to ur-60, ur-62, ur-66.
rulings.precedent: BRIEF exceptions (official names of organisations); ur-63 approved wording.

rulings.title: ur-60 «خلیجی اقامہ»
rulings.ruling: Not «خلیج عرب کے ممالک کا اقامہ» (05) nor «خلیج عرب کا اقامہ» (a residency of a sea): «خلیج تعاون کونسل کے کسی ملک کا اقامہ» — a residency is issued by one state; the build is ur-63's. «اقامہ» masculine, «کا» and «والا» agree.
rulings.precedent: G-UR-3; ur-63; en «Holders of a GCC residency».

rulings.title: Gulf states outside the visa guide
rulings.ruling: Where the source says «دول الخليج» / «the Gulf states» with no Council, the form is «خلیج عرب کے ممالک» («خلیج عرب کے تمام ممالک» for «كافة دول الخليج العربي»): the Council is not named where the source does not name it (no new fact). «الخليجية» of an agreement between those states is «خلیج عرب کے ممالک کے …».
rulings.precedent: BRIEF «خلیج عرب کے ممالک»; no-invention rule.

rulings.title: Exceptions
rulings.ruling: «الخلیج سڑک» (N172) and «خلیج تعاون کونسل» unchanged in all 20 kept positions.

amendments.append: SUPERSEDED 2026-10-27 by owner ruling O-GULF (batch gulf-unify-1027, judge 07): the Gulf is «خلیج عرب», no izafat sign (P8), in every reference — sea, coast, region, states, cuisine, heritage; the adjective «خلیجی» is never written and is rebuilt as «خلیج عرب کے …»; a repeated reference carries the name too; «خلیج فارس» is never written. Exceptions: the road «الخلیج سڑک» (N172) and the official «خلیج تعاون کونسل», which is also written wherever the source means the GCC (en «GCC», ar «دول المجلس»), as on the visa guide. The guard becomes: no word «خلیج» not followed by « عرب» except «خلیج تعاون کونسل»; no «خلیجی»; no «خلیج فارس».

termbase_notes.append: New key (O-GULF, 2026-10-27). Forms: خلیج عرب کا ساحل / کے ساحل پر / کے کنارے / کی نیلاہٹ / بھر کا / میں; خلیج عرب کے خطے (for «خلیجی خطہ»); خلیج عرب کے ممالک / کے تمام ممالک; خلیج عرب کے کھانوں; خلیج عرب کے ممالک کے اقتصادی معاہدے. Source: ur.wikipedia «خلیج عرب» (read 2026-10-27). Blind reader (Pakistan) first read it as «بحیرہ عرب», resolved from context: accepted as inherent (G-UR-2).

Written wherever the source means the GCC, including «Gulf residency» / «Gulf states» of the visa guide: «خلیج تعاون کونسل کے ممالک میں مقیم افراد», «خلیج تعاون کونسل کے کسی ملک کا اقامہ» (gulf-unify-1027, G-UR-3/4).
asfar's guarded claim now reads «خلیج عرب کے خطے کے سب سے بڑے آبی اجسام میں سے ایک»; the C31 Urdu pattern must be re-derived from it (the three guarded points unchanged).
«خلیجی عرب ممالک» superseded: «خلیج عرب کے ممالک» (events.ts kafu intro), «عرب» inside the name.
Guard «خلیج carries no qualifier (P5)» is void: the road key «الخلیج سڑک» stays byte for byte; the article-attached «الخلیج» is not the Gulf name.
